title: headwater-find/1
description: What `headwater find --json` prints: the background processes that match, the best first. Example: `headwater find electricity --release toy-background@6864b7dbb65d --json`.

process_id.description: The supplier to write in a study file.

flow_id.description: The id of the reference product: the flow the process makes, or the waste it treats.

unit.description: The unit of the reference product.

why.description: The rule that matched, such as `name starts with`.
